reviews.title: FRAUD - SCAM
reviews.text: Don’t get this app, it is a scam! If I could give 0 stars I would. This app charged me initially. Then immediately within minutes tried to charge double the amount. Luckily it got denied because it looked suspicious. I tried to then email support to tell them I’d like a refund since I had cancelled the subscription, got an automated email. Then the next morning had an alert from my bank that ANOTHER charge had tried to go through. Thankfully they only got the initial $25 as of now, still going to try and dispute that, but they tried to charge an additional $49.99 + $25. Save yourself the time and energy and money.

reviews.title: It’s okay but not free.
reviews.text: Looks like there’s a lot of features and a lot of great items to track your calories and see the different stages of your body when fasting but unfortunately, you have to have premium for you to use them all. Every time you sign in the app, it always ask you to upgrade to premium and with the basic free version it’s very limited. It’s honestly quite annoying when an app is free but for you to use the features, you have to buy the in app premium service, which seems extremely expensive to me just to lose weight. It’s probably cheaper grabbing a gym membership and going to the gym yourself.
